Runs at [collegica.org/apps/owl-sessions/](https://www.collegica.org/apps/owl-sessions/)
(formerly /sessions/, which redirects there), and full screen at /app/
beneath it, where it installs to a phone's home screen and works offline.
Nothing is uploaded. Built and released from
[its own repository](https://github.com/Collegica/owl-sessions), with the
clips, the prompts they came from and a contact sheet per clip; the
release pinned in website/apps.yml is unpacked into the site at deploy
time. The demonstrator is generated, and the form was checked by a
person, not a trainer.

The routine it runs, and how the clips were made and checked, are in
[A Session You Can Keep](/aging-well/exercise-sessions.md).
